literal_source_claim: Regular partition of a dense graph.
candidate_claim_not_credited_as_statemen: For every finite simple graph G, positive real epsilon, and natural l no larger than the vertex count, there exists an epsilon-uniform equipartition of all vertices into between l and bound(epsilon,l) parts.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_type: under DecidableEq alpha, Fintype alpha, G : SimpleGraph alpha, DecidableRel G.Adj: 0 < epsilon -> l <= Fintype.card alpha -> Exists P : Finpartition Finset.univ, P.IsEquipartition and l <= P.parts.card and P.parts.card <= SzemerediRegularity.bound epsilon l and P.IsUniform G epsilon
